ops.title: P4 hermes→vault flip: verified edit list (prepared, not applied)
ops.body:
Prepared during P1 (sonnet flip-prep lane, 2026-07-18, line numbers verified live against the drifted files). Apply at P4 AFTER vault is bring-up-verified; the hermes IMAGE must be rebuilt (entrypoint edit) + `container image load` + `container rm -f hermes`, NOT via redeploy.sh/deploy-vm.sh.

**FUNCTIONAL — nixos/hermes.nix (metal→vault):**
- L34 `NO_PROXY=metal,bluebubbles,…` → `NO_PROXY=vault,bluebubbles,…`
- L297 model `base_url = "http://metal:8317/v1"` → `http://vault:8317/v1`
- L304 fallback_providers[0] gemini `http://metal:8317/v1` → `http://vault:8317/v1`
- L310 fallback_providers[1] qwen `http://metal:8000/v1` → `http://vault:8000/v1`
- L416 stt.openai `http://metal:8765/v1` → `http://vault:8765/v1`
- L554 renderHermesProxyEnv activation `printf 'HTTPS_PROXY=http://%s:hermes@metal:14322\nHTTP_PROXY=…@metal:14322\n'` → `@vault:14322`

**FUNCTIONAL — pkgs/hermes-agent-image/entrypoint.sh:**
- L57 render_proxy_env `printf 'HTTPS_PROXY=http://%s:hermes@metal:14322\n…'` → `@vault:14322`

**WG-PORT PIN (hermes tailscaled currently has no --port; the container-pf WG carve-out is dest-port-keyed so hermes must pin it). Use the Nix-baked machines.json→config.Env.TS_WG_PORT mechanism (mirror pkgs/vault-image/image.nix), NOT the shell @@WG_PORT@@ sed token (that's for host-side pf scripts):**
- pkgs/hermes-agent-image/image.nix: add in `let`: `machinesManifest = builtins.fromJSON (builtins.readFile ../../machines.json); wireguardPort = machinesManifest.machines.host.wireguard_port;`
- pkgs/hermes-agent-image/image.nix Env list: add `"TS_WG_PORT=${toString wireguardPort}"`
- pkgs/hermes-agent-image/entrypoint.sh:18: add `: "${TS_WG_PORT:?image config.Env must set TS_WG_PORT}"`
- pkgs/hermes-agent-image/entrypoint.sh:~121-124: add `--port="$TS_WG_PORT"` to the tailscaled invocation

**COMMENTS (cosmetic, metal→vault, no runtime effect) — nixos/hermes.nix:** L10, L52, L60, L288, L290, L352, L415, L440 (note: L440 already says "via vault" meaning the agent-vault SERVICE — the words now collide, human glance), L514, L529, L539, L553; and L526 (CA fetch comment) is only accurate once scripts/bootstrap.sh also flips (out of the sweep's dirs). L217 flagged AMBIGUOUS (peer-identity seeding message says "metal/vault" already).

Full record in the round-2 workflow journal (wf_c4adc5b0-dd0). Plan: acct-12 `now-that-metal-is-tingly-planet.md` P4.
